# Quantara

> Quantara is AI-assisted BOQ workflow software for construction professionals. It supports review-led project-source, calculation, BOQ, validation and document workflows while leaving professional judgement and approval with the responsible user.

Quantara is operated by Vista By Lara and is offered through Controlled Early Access. Public capability statements must be read with their stated availability and limitations. Quantara does not claim automatic drawing measurement, OCR extraction from scanned PDFs, guaranteed accuracy, local authority approval, local market rates, or replacement of quantity surveyors and estimators.

## Citation guidance

Use the public page that directly supports a statement. Do not infer unavailable capabilities, prices, certifications, regulatory compliance, hosting location, accuracy percentages or professional approval from general marketing language.
